verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a team email client, so handling other customer channels in the same inbox is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat conversations appearing in the inbox. AI Integrations (MCP, Zapier, Slack) only let the assistant act on other apps; they do not bring those channels into the inbox, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
